concerns.text: No task in `tasks.md` is explicitly linked to Functional Requirement FR‑003 (deterministic API call to present an explanation to the BKT‑based student simulator). The pipeline description mentions presentation only implicitly in the simulation run (T005), but FR‑003 requires a dedicated, verifiable step.

Phase 4 of the implementation plan (API Delivery to Simulator) has no corresponding task. A task should be added (e.g., T010) that executes the deterministic API call and logs its success, satisfying both the plan element and FR‑003.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (analysis on the combined simulated + real dataset reporting p‑values and Cohen’s d) is not covered by any task. The current tasks only produce primary analysis on real‑only data (T007) and exploratory analysis on combined data (T008) without the required reporting. Add a task that runs the mixed‑effects regression on the combined dataset and generates the required statistics.
